ministry_department: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
benefit_description: ₹15,000 Toolkit Grant + Collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate + PM Vishwakarma ID Card & Skill Training stipend.
eligibility_conditions: Must be a traditional artisan or craftsman working with hands and tools.
Minimum age of 18 years at the date of registration.
Must not have availed similar credit under PMEGP or MUDRA in last 5 years.

scheme_name: Pehchan Artisan National Identity Card Scheme
ministry_department: Office of Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles
benefit_description: National Artisan Identity Card issuing free stall access at Dilli Haat, Surajkund Crafts Mela, financial support for exhibitions, and subsidized health/life insurance.
eligibility_conditions: Must be a practicing handicraft artisan in India.
required_documents: Sample Product Photo or Craft Work Evidence

ministry_department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME
benefit_description: Credit-linked capital margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% for setting up new micro-manufacturing craft units up to ₹50 Lakh project cost.
eligibility_conditions: Any individual artisan above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing sector.
required_documents: Caste / Special Category Certificate (if claiming 35% subsidy)

ministry_department: Coir Board, Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
benefit_description: 75% Subsidy on motorized ratts / coir spinning equipment for rural women artisans + monthly training stipend.
eligibility_conditions: Exclusively for rural female artisans engaged in coir and natural fiber craft spinning.

ministry_department: Office of Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles
benefit_description: Grant-in-aid support for artisan Self-Help Groups (SHGs) to establish Common Facility Centres (CFCs), raw material depots, and design technical workshops.
eligibility_conditions: Artisan Self-Help Group (SHG) or Cooperative consisting of at least 10–20 practicing artisans.
Must be engaged in recognized traditional handicraft craft clusters.
required_documents: List of Artisan Members with Pehchan Card / Aadhaar details

scheme_name: Karnataka Artisan Development & Toolkit Subsidy Scheme
ministry_department: Department of Handlooms & Textiles, Government of Karnataka
benefit_description: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 for improved toolkits and capital subsidy for traditional artisans operating in Karnataka State.
eligibility_conditions: Must be a domicile resident of Karnataka State.
Must be practicing a traditional Karnataka heritage craft (e.g. Channapatna Toys, Clay Pottery, Woodcarving).
